adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` now sets `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `.find(...)` branch runs), it searches for a destination calendar whose `externalId` equals that same falsy value, which will almost always return `undefined` (making the fallback effectively dead). The same pattern is used for `calendarId` in `deleteEvent`, so the finding is directly verifiable from the diff and represents broken selection logic.
